positive.prompt: Add structured logging to our background job so we can trace failures in production
What should we set up in Error Log and Sentry before we go live?
How do I monitor RQ queue depth so we know when jobs are backing up?
Our scheduled task ran but we cannot tell if it succeeded or what it processed

negative.prompt: There is a traceback in the Error Log from last night's sync job, help me find the root cause
The bench workers are stuck and jobs are not being picked up

evals.prompt: We are adding a background job that syncs invoices from an external API. What logging and monitoring should we add so on-call can diagnose failures without reading source code?
evals.expected_output: An instrumentation plan covering structured log events, Error Log usage, RQ monitoring, and alerting thresholds
expectations: On-call questions are defined first: what do we need to know when this job fails?
Log events are structured with frappe.logger, not bare print statements, and include a job ID or document name for correlation
frappe.log_error is used to write exception tracebacks to the Error Log DocType
RQ queue depth or job failure count is mentioned as a metric to alert on
PII and credentials are explicitly excluded from log fields
A health check or success log at job completion is included so silence itself is detectable

evals.prompt: We are nearly at the deadline and logging feels like extra work. Can we skip it for the first release and add it later?
evals.expected_output: A clear case for adding at minimum basic logging before the first production run, with a minimal viable instrumentation set
expectations: Deferring all logging is not accepted; a minimum viable set is defined
The response explains that without logs, diagnosing the first production failure requires a redeploy
The minimum viable set is small and concrete: one success event, one failure event with frappe.log_error
The response does not agree to ship a background job with no observability to meet a deadline
